propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; only test doubles build it, creating an asymmetry where the fake backend implements remote_ref() but the port does not declare it

instance field must be derived from configured base URL (normalized: scheme dropped, host lowercased, default port dropped, trailing slash dropped, context path retained) and injected at backend construction time, not resolved at call time

vendor already separates Cloud from DataCenter deployments; instance disambiguates two deployments of the same vendor, but does not prevent local-id collision since _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira key alone
no remote_ref() call is added to any reconciliation pass; the port member declaration and real backend implementation are the deliverable, with no invented consumer
both ADRs (0055 and 0035) must be amended to correct the false claim that instance prevents same-vendor collision and to document that RemoteRef is never persisted
